Both responses give correct figures ($2,500 for simple interest and about $4,322 for compound interest over 30 years at 5% on $1,000). The deciding factor is the word limit. Response A is about 100 words and complies with the "under 120 words" instruction. Response B is about 125 words, so it exceeds the limit, even though its formatting and Rule of 72 tip are useful.
